summary: Mechanics Bancorp, via its wholly owned subsidiary Mechanics Bank, filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting the completed sale of its Fannie Mae Delegated Underwriting and Servicing business line to Fifth Third Bank for aggregate cash consideration of approximately $126 million. The transaction closed on May 1, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee were disclosed. The sale was previously announced and is now complete, with the registrant receiving cash. This is a non-core asset divestiture. Watch for potential use of proceeds, such as capital returns or reinvestment, and any impact on future earnings.
